The single complete28-path patch SHA256 is `85875a3597b2b3ea6a6df9df68d81237d4db89b45dc288aa86953f5267da0adb`; its manifest and individual follow-up commits are included. The original dc6 full suite is preserved as FAILED:1375 executed methods,3 class setup errors/10 blocked methods. The ten blocked methods subsequently passed after focused source-lineage/original-model fixture repairs. Final-head targeted Python20passed and all8 Node commands passed, preserving an earlier parallel deadline failure and its successful unchanged serial retry. Literal boolean completion is now required across all6 boundaries; the two consumer inventories/config/workflow hashes match. All8 frozen engine files and original scientific registrations remain unchanged. Independent source review found no blocker.

This is not a final-head full CI or deployment claim. Please reconcile the actual owner branch and scope, integrate the applicable full variant, run the required combined hosted CI, and return exact source/build/data/deployment identities for live audit. Prior prerequisite/scope changes still apply. This Phase2 work does not hold up the separately ready current-Main COUNT7 correction. Existing writer/scheduler ownership remains yours; no takeover, new scheduler, protected-outcome tuning or new fits.
